meta.title: The Abyss Protocol
meta.subject: teamwork
meta.author: mission_architect
meta.historical_note: Inspired by the true events of Soviet submarine B-59 during the Cuban Missile Crisis, October 27, 1962. USS Beale and the carrier group of USS Randolph hunted B-59 near the Sargasso Sea. Crew endured 50°C+ temperatures, failing batteries, and days without contact from Moscow.

direct.label: Emergency dive! Take her down!
direct.narrator_line: Helmsman! Emergency dive — take her deep!

direct.label: Blow ballast — SURFACE!
direct.narrator_line: Helmsman! Blow main ballast — take her up!

direct.label: Hard to port! Evade!
direct.narrator_line: Hard to port! Evasive maneuver — NOW!

direct.label: Hard starboard! Torpedo wake!
direct.narrator_line: Hard starboard — torpedo wake in the water!

direct.label: Full forward ballast!
direct.narrator_line: Helmsman! Full forward trim — nose her down!

direct.label: Trim ballast to half!
direct.narrator_line: Trim ballast to fifty percent — level her out!

direct.label: Ballast full aft!
direct.narrator_line: Full aft trim! Get the bow up!

direct.label: Port engine — AHEAD!
direct.narrator_line: Port engine ahead! Give me turns!

direct.label: Port engine — ALL STOP!
direct.narrator_line: Port engine all stop!

direct.label: Starboard engine — AHEAD!
direct.narrator_line: Starboard engine ahead!

direct.label: Starboard engine — STOP!
direct.narrator_line: Starboard engine all stop — quiet in the boat!

direct.label: Emergency blow NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency blow! All hands — emergency surface!

direct.label: Power output to maximum!
direct.narrator_line: Chief! Power to maximum — everything she's got!

direct.label: Reduce power to half!
direct.narrator_line: Reduce power to fifty percent — conserve batteries!

direct.label: Power to quarter — conserve!
direct.narrator_line: Quarter power only! We're draining the batteries!

direct.label: Cut main power!
direct.narrator_line: Chief! Cut main power — silent running!

direct.label: Seal the main valve!
direct.narrator_line: Chief Engineer! Seal the main valve — we're leaking!

direct.label: Reactor cooling — ON!
direct.narrator_line: Reactor cooling on! Temperatures are climbing!

direct.label: Reactor cooling — SECURE!
direct.narrator_line: Secure cooling — the Americans will hear the pumps!

direct.label: Switch to battery power!
direct.narrator_line: Battery power! Switch now — go electric!

direct.label: Battery power — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Cut battery power — back to reactor!

direct.label: Bilge pump — ACTIVATE!
direct.narrator_line: Bilge pump on! We've got water in the engine room!

direct.label: Bilge pump — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Secure the bilge pump — water's under control!

direct.label: Patch: main power routing!
direct.narrator_line: Chief! Patch bay — main power routing!

direct.label: Patch: backup power link!
direct.narrator_line: Patch bay to backup config — swap those leads!

direct.label: Patch: emergency bypass!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency bypass — reroute the patch bay NOW!

direct.label: Radio to frequency 142!
direct.narrator_line: Radio Operator! Tune to one-four-two — Moscow relay!

direct.label: Tune to frequency 77!
direct.narrator_line: Frequency seventy-seven — fleet emergency band!

direct.label: Emergency frequency 200!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency frequency two hundred — distress call!

direct.label: Moscow relay — frequency 50!
direct.narrator_line: Try frequency fifty — maybe Moscow is still there!

direct.label: Raise the antenna mast!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the antenna mast — we need to listen!

direct.label: Retract antenna — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Retract the mast! They'll spot it on radar!

direct.label: Engage cipher mode!
direct.narrator_line: Engage cipher — encrypt all transmissions!

direct.label: Disengage cipher!
direct.narrator_line: Drop cipher — we need speed over secrecy!

direct.label: Send the signal burst!
direct.narrator_line: Compressed burst — transmit NOW!

direct.label: Clear the static!
direct.narrator_line: Clear that static — I can't hear a thing!

direct.label: Enter cipher code 1-9-6-2!
direct.narrator_line: Radio! Cipher code one-nine-six-two — authenticate!

direct.label: Enter code 5-5-9!
direct.narrator_line: B-fifty-nine auth code — five-five-nine!

direct.label: Emergency code 3-0-7!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency override — three-zero-seven!

direct.label: Authenticate TORPEDO KEY!
direct.narrator_line: Weapons Officer! Authenticate the torpedo key — now!

direct.label: Unlock the CAPTAIN'S SAFE!
direct.narrator_line: Open the Captain's safe! We need the sealed orders!

direct.label: Launch mode — STANDBY!
direct.narrator_line: Weapons Officer! Set launch mode to standby!

direct.label: Launch mode — ARMED!
direct.narrator_line: Arm the tubes! Launch mode to armed — position two!

direct.label: Launch mode — SAFE!
direct.narrator_line: Safe the weapons! Launch mode to safe — position three!

direct.label: Lock torpedo tube 2!
direct.narrator_line: Lock tube two! Secure it!

direct.label: Unlock torpedo tube 2!
direct.narrator_line: Unlock tube two — make ready!

direct.label: Lock torpedo tube 3!
direct.narrator_line: Lock tube three!

direct.label: Unlock tube 3!
direct.narrator_line: Unlock tube three — prepare to fire!

direct.label: Flood torpedo tubes!
direct.narrator_line: Flood all tubes! Stand by!

direct.label: O2 mix to BLUE zone!
direct.narrator_line: Doctor! O2 mix to blue — standard breathing atmosphere!

direct.label: O2 mix to GREEN — standard!
direct.narrator_line: Green zone O2 — enriched mix for the crew!

direct.label: O2 mix to RED — emergency!
direct.narrator_line: Doctor! Red zone — emergency oxygen levels! Move!

direct.label: CO2 scrubber to 150!
direct.narrator_line: Scrubber to one-fifty! The air is getting thick!

direct.label: Reduce scrubber to 80!
direct.narrator_line: Ease the scrubber to eighty — save the filters!

direct.label: Scrubber to 250 — MAX!
direct.narrator_line: Maximum scrubbing! Two-fifty — men are passing out!

direct.label: Seal the pressure lock!
direct.narrator_line: Seal the compartment! Pressure lock — now!

direct.label: Release pressure lock!
direct.narrator_line: Release the pressure lock — let them through!

direct.label: Check crew vitals!
direct.narrator_line: Doctor! Check the crew — anyone showing symptoms?

direct.label: Adrenaline — revive him!
direct.narrator_line: Adrenaline shot! That man collapsed — revive him!

direct.label: Plot course: 2-7-0!
direct.narrator_line: Navigation Officer! Plot course two-seven-zero — west!

direct.label: Enter coordinates: 1-8-3-5!
direct.narrator_line: Coordinates one-eight-three-five — deep water trench!

direct.label: Bearing: 0-9-0 — due east!
direct.narrator_line: Navigation! Bearing zero-nine-zero — due east!

direct.label: Depth bearing — position THREE!
direct.narrator_line: Depth chart — mark position three!

direct.label: Depth bearing — position FIVE!
direct.narrator_line: Position five on the depth chart — deep water!

direct.label: Depth bearing — position ONE!
direct.narrator_line: Position one — shallow water! Check the chart!

direct.label: Calculate drift current!
direct.narrator_line: Calculate the current — we're drifting off course!

direct.label: Stow current tables!
direct.narrator_line: Stow the tables — we have what we need!

direct.label: Fix our position!
direct.narrator_line: Fix our position! Where are we?

direct.label: Stow position fix!
direct.narrator_line: Position fix noted — stow the instruments!

direct.label: Mark the contact!
direct.narrator_line: Mark that contact on the plot — bearing and range!

direct.label: Sonar sweep — SOUTHEAST!
direct.narrator_line: Sonar! Sweep southeast — bearing one-four-zero!

direct.label: Sonar sweep — SOUTHWEST!
direct.narrator_line: Two-two-zero — I heard something. Sweep southwest!

direct.label: Sonar sweep — NORTHEAST!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing sixty — new contact? Sweep northeast!

direct.label: Switch to passive sonar!
direct.narrator_line: Passive sonar only! They'll hear us pinging!

direct.label: Active sonar — PING!
direct.narrator_line: One active ping — just one! I need a range!

direct.label: Bow array — LISTEN!
direct.narrator_line: Bow array active — listen forward!

direct.label: Bow array — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Cut the bow array — reduce our noise!

direct.label: Stern array — activate!
direct.narrator_line: Stern array! What's behind us?

direct.label: Stern array — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Stern array off — too much noise aft!

direct.label: Report hull stress!
direct.narrator_line: Report hull stress levels — are we holding?

direct.label: Match RED — hostile contact!
direct.narrator_line: Sonar! Spectrum to red — hostile contact!

direct.label: Match BLUE — friendly signal!
direct.narrator_line: Blue spectrum — friendly vessel signature!

direct.label: Match GREEN — all clear!
direct.narrator_line: Green spectrum — confirm all clear!

direct.label: Patch: SILENT RUNNING!
direct.narrator_line: Executive Officer! Patch panel — silent running config!

direct.label: Patch: EVASIVE ACTION!
direct.narrator_line: Evasive action! Patch panel to evasive routing!

direct.label: Patch: FLANK SPEED!
direct.narrator_line: Flank speed — patch it through! Everything she's got!

direct.label: Patch: PREPARE TO SURFACE!
direct.narrator_line: Prepare to surface! Patch to surfacing config!

direct.label: Confirm that order!
direct.narrator_line: Confirm the order! Repeat it back!

direct.label: Captain's key — TURN IT!
direct.narrator_line: Turn the Captain's key! Authorization required!

direct.label: Captain's key — REMOVE!
direct.narrator_line: Remove the Captain's key — stand down!

direct.label: ALL STATIONS REPORT!
direct.narrator_line: All stations — REPORT! Status from every compartment!

direct.label: Update the deck log!
direct.narrator_line: Log it! Time, depth, heading — in the record!

direct.label: Scan CAPTAIN'S authorization!
direct.narrator_line: XO! Scan the Captain's authorization card — now!

direct.label: Scan NUCLEAR launch card!
direct.narrator_line: Nuclear authorization — scan the launch card!

cooperative.narrator_line: XO! Tell the Helmsman — emergency dive!

cooperative.narrator_line: Chief! Shout to the Helmsman — full forward ballast!

cooperative.narrator_line: XO! Tell the Chief — half power only!

cooperative.narrator_line: Helmsman! Tell Radio — tune to one-four-two!

cooperative.label: Tell Radio: frequency 77!
cooperative.narrator_line: Sonar! Shout to Radio — frequency seventy-seven!

cooperative.narrator_line: Radio! Tell the Weapons Officer — flood all tubes!

cooperative.label: Tell Weapons: lock tube 2!
cooperative.narrator_line: Doctor! Tell Weapons — lock torpedo tube two!

cooperative.narrator_line: Chief! Shout to the Doctor — seal that compartment!

cooperative.narrator_line: Weapons! Tell the Doctor — adrenaline, man down!

cooperative.label: Tell XO: patch silent running!
cooperative.narrator_line: Sonar! Tell the XO — patch panel to silent running!

cooperative.narrator_line: Doctor! Shout to the XO — turn the Captain's key!

open.narrator_line: Anyone with a helm stick — dive NOW!

open.label: Anyone — power to MAXIMUM!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a fader — full power NOW!

open.label: Quick — tune to 142!
open.narrator_line: Any dial operator — tune to one-four-two!

open.narrator_line: Anyone with a color dial — match yellow NOW!

open.narrator_line: Whoever has a selector — position two!

open.narrator_line: Anyone with a keypad — code five-five-nine!

crises.label: DEPTH CHARGES! BRACE!
crises.narrator_line: DEPTH CHARGES! ALL HANDS — GRAB HOLD! BRACE! BRACE! BRACE!

crises.label: HULL BUCKLING!
crises.narrator_line: THE HULL IS BUCKLING! At least four of you — shore up the bulkheads!

crises.label: REACTOR SCRAM!
crises.narrator_line: REACTOR SCRAM! Chief — restore power! Sonar — keep listening! Everyone else — emergency stations!

crises.label: BATTERY FIRE!
crises.narrator_line: FIRE IN THE BATTERY COMPARTMENT! Doctor — seal it! Radio — kill the cipher! Everyone — MOVE!

narrator_lines: October twenty-seventh, nineteen sixty-two. You are the crew of B-fifty-nine.
Soviet Navy. Foxtrot-class submarine. Four days submerged near the Sargasso Sea.
Batteries at fifteen percent. Interior temperature exceeding fifty degrees.
Moscow has been silent for forty-eight hours. Above us, the American destroyer USS Beale and her carrier group are hunting.
They are dropping depth charges — signaling us to surface. We will not comply.
All stations, report ready. We go deeper. We survive this.

phases.narrator_intro: All stations, set your controls to starting positions. Confirm each when your display lights green.

narrator_lines_ambient: Maintain three hundred metres. Not a sound.
The Americans are pinging. Hold steady — let them pass overhead.
Battery levels dropping. Conserve everything.
That was a practice charge. They want us to surface. Ignore it.

narrator_lines: Good work. We've slipped past the first destroyer screen.
USS Beale is searching to the west. We have a window — but more ships are coming.
They have us. The Beale is directly overhead — her sonar has a fix on us.
More destroyers converging. Helicopter dipping sonar to the south. Think fast.

narrator_lines_ambient: New contacts — the carrier USS Randolph has launched anti-submarine aircraft.
Three hundred twenty metres. The hull is groaning. Watch the gauges.
Air quality deteriorating. CO2 levels climbing. Keep the scrubbers running.
Silent running. If anyone drops a wrench, we are all dead.
Depth charges — closer now. They know exactly where we are.
The Captain is shouting. The crew is near breaking point. Hold together.
Fifty-two degrees in the engine room. Men collapsing from the heat.
Batteries at eight percent. We cannot stay down much longer.

narrator_lines: A thermocline layer — we've found a thermal boundary! Sound won't pass through it.
We're invisible to their sonar. Quiet now. Slip away.
The aircraft spotted our shadow. They're vectoring destroyers onto us.
Batteries critical. Air is poison. One last gamble — take her deeper.
An undersea canyon — the charts show a trench ahead! We can lose them in the deep.
All ahead. Into the trench. This is our chance.
They have us boxed in. The Captain is desperate. Oxygen failing.
This is it. Every man to his station. We surface or we die down here.

narrator_lines_ambient: Below the thermocline. Sonar can't find us — but the hull can't take this depth.
Creeping ahead at two knots. Absolute silence.
The battery gauge is on zero. We are running on fumes.
Just a bit further. Hold it together. Almost clear.
Three hundred fifty metres. Beyond rated depth. The rivets are screaming.
Men are hallucinating from CO2. Keep them focused.
If one more system fails, we surface whether we want to or not.
The Americans are directly above. Depth charges falling like rain.
Into the trench — four hundred metres and dropping. Maximum depth.
The destroyers are circling above, but the canyon walls scatter their sonar.
Hold course. Steady. Don't touch the walls.
Battery alarm sounding. Shut it off — manually — before they hear it.
This is the end. Batteries dead. Air gone. We must surface.
The Captain has ordered emergency blow. Make it happen.
Prepare to face the Americans. With dignity.
Controlled ascent. Every system — give me everything you have left.

WWW.title: Silent Escape
narrator_lines: B-fifty-nine slips beneath the thermocline and vanishes from American sonar.
Three days later, the submarine surfaces in international waters. Every soul aboard alive.
The world will never know how close it came. But the crew of B-fifty-nine will remember.
You held the line. In silence, in darkness, in fifty-degree heat. You survived.

WWL.title: Damaged but Free
narrator_lines: B-fifty-nine surfaces damaged but intact, far from the American search pattern.
The batteries are dead. The air is poison. But the crew is alive.
A Soviet supply ship reaches you within thirty-six hours. You are going home.

WLW.title: Deep Dive Recovery
narrator_lines: A desperate deep dive beyond rated depth. The hull screamed. But it held.
B-fifty-nine escapes through a thermal layer the Americans never suspected.
Battered, exhausted, barely functional. But free. A remarkable recovery.

WLL.title: Forced to Surface
narrator_lines: No choice. Emergency surface. The Americans are waiting.
USS Beale escorts B-fifty-nine to the surface. The crew emerges blinking into sunlight.
Alive, but the mission is a failure. Moscow will not be pleased.

LWW.title: Against All Odds
narrator_lines: From the jaws of disaster, the crew rallied. The undersea trench saved you.
B-fifty-nine limps into open water and surfaces under cover of darkness.
A legendary feat of submarine seamanship. From hopeless to free. Well done.

LWL.title: Captured but Alive
narrator_lines: Forced to surface after the batteries die completely. The Americans circle overhead.
The crew is evacuated onto USS Beale. Humiliating, but every man walks off alive.
There will be questions in Moscow. But your crew survived. That matters.

LLW.title: Last Miracle
narrator_lines: One last miracle. A current carried B-fifty-nine into a sonar shadow.
You surface in international waters, barely afloat. The submarine may never dive again.
But the crew of B-fifty-nine is alive. Against all odds.

LLL.title: Surfaced and Seized
narrator_lines: All systems dead. Emergency blow fires the last compressed air.
B-fifty-nine broaches the surface like a dying whale. The Americans surround her.
The submarine is towed to port. The crew is interned. The mission is over.
But you are alive. On this day, in October nineteen sixty-two, that is enough.

between_commands_lines: Stay focused. Lives depend on it.
Do not make me repeat myself.
